description: Block-centric plate tank - mitigation stacks off blocks rather than avoidance, Formations trade speed for damage reduction, and Raise Shield resets off your own strikes.
_source_note: Rebuilt from reference/coa_sidekick/talents/guardian.json, the real CoA Vanguard tree (38 nodes behind 3 point gates plus five free level-gated passives). Every node here is a real CoA node carrying CoA's own effect. Its stat priority is Defense > Stamina > Expertise > Block Rating/Value > Strength > Dodge/Parry, which is why the tree spends far more on block chance and block value than on avoidance.

nodes.name: Iron Guardian
nodes.description: Increases your Stamina by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your Stamina by 5%. (up to 3 ranks)'. The first pass had this as max_health_pct, which is a FRACTION in this engine - authored as 2.0 it granted +200% a rank.

nodes.name: Heavy Expert
nodes.description: Increases your chance to parry and dodge by 1.5% and your Armor by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your chance to parry and dodge by 4% and increase your Armor contribution from mail and plate items by 20%.' Armour-by-item-type has no engine hook, so it lands as flat Armor; spread over 3 ranks rather than CoA's single point to fit Frontier's tier budget.

nodes.name: Footman's Call
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Pulverize by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Pulverize is increased by 15, plus an additional amount scaling with your block value.' The block-value scaling has no hook. NOT a threat talent - the first pass used this name for threat.

nodes.name: With Honor
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Ram by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cooldown of Ram by -4 sec.'

nodes.name: Knight's Conviction
nodes.description: Increases the damage your blocks absorb by 8% and your block chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the block value provided by Raise Shield by 25% and your block chance by 1%. (up to 2 ranks)'

nodes.name: Seasoned Fighter
nodes.description: Reduces the Energy cost of your abilities by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the Energy cost of Pulverize, Ram, and Broad Sweep by -10%.' Engine-wide rather than per ability - there is no per-ability cost key for three abilities at once.

nodes.name: Stalwart
nodes.description: Increases the damage your blocks absorb by 5% and grants 2 hit rating per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your block value by 10% and your expertise by 4. (up to 2 ranks)'. No expertise key exists; hit rating is the nearest live stat.

nodes.name: Valiant Defender
nodes.description: Increases your maximum Energy by 5 and the damage of Pulverize by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your maximum Energy by 15 and increases the damage of Pulverize and Broad Sweep by 10%.'

nodes.name: Bulwark
nodes.description: Increases the damage your blocks absorb by 25% and grants 5 hit rating.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Level 20 Passive. Increases your block value by 25% and your hit rating by 5% of your Stamina.' The Stamina-into-hit conversion is real in CoA and cannot be expressed here: hit_rating is a local feeding base_miss_chance_*, not a Character attribute, so it cannot be a <target>_from_<source>_pct target without restructuring that loop. Flat hit instead.

nodes.name: Retaliation
nodes.description: Blows you turn aside on your shield are answered in kind.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Successful blocks now deal AP Physical damage to the attacker, scaling with defense rating. Can only occur once per sec.'

nodes.name: Vanguard's Shield
nodes.description: Reduces the Magic damage you take by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Blocking an attack or landing an auto attack now grants a stack of Vanguard ... Magic Damage taken reduced.' The stacking half has no hook, so it is a flat reduction - and it is the only magic mitigation in the tree, which matters because the tank sweep flags Guardian as scoring zero there.

nodes.name: Bring Down The Hammer!
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Heavy Blow by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Heavy Blow now deals an additional 20% of the damage dealt every 1 sec for 3 seconds.' A bleed-on-hit has no shape here, so the damage lands up front.

nodes.name: Iron Barrier
nodes.description: Your blocks absorb an additional 5% of the damage dealt to you, per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Level 30 Passive. Your successful blocks now have a 50% chance to critically block for twice the normal amount.' block_bonus_reduction is the engine's existing critical-block hook, read in Character.take_damage.

nodes.name: Forceful Impact
nodes.description: Brace lasts 1 turn longer per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Raise Shield and Heavy Blow now extends the duration of your Brace by 1 sec.'

nodes.name: Vanguard's Might
nodes.description: Heavy Blow leaves your allies taking 5% less damage per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Heavy Blow now causes you to emanate an aura for 5 seconds that reduces all damage taken by -5% for party members.'

nodes.name: Resilient
nodes.description: Increases your total health by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Blocking an attack while Raise Shield is active now increases your maximum health by AP for 15 seconds.' Conditional max-health has no hook; flat.

nodes.name: Footman's Calling
nodes.description: While holding a Formation you take 2% less damage and generate 6% more threat, per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Level 10 Passive. Your damage taken is reduced by -10% while Tower Formation or Line Formation is active. In addition, your threat generated from Physical [damage is increased].' THE tree's threat talent - 3 ranks give +18%, just under Warrior Defiance's 24%, since Guardian trades threat for the best mitigation in the game. Note threat_generation_pct is a FRACTION as a talent effect and percent POINTS as an ability buff stat_mod.

nodes.name: Experienced Soldier
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Brace by 1 turn.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Level 40 Passive. Melee attacks now reduce the cooldown of Brace by -1 sec.'

nodes.name: The Green Tower
nodes.description: Increases your Armor by 3% per rank and cheapens your Formations.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the Energy cost of your Formations and increases their effectiveness by 25%.'

nodes.name: Hold the Line
nodes.description: Reduces the duration of stuns used against you by 15% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Command nearby allies to hold the line, making them immune to incapacitate, disorient, knockback, and grip effects for 15 seconds.' Party immunity has no hook, so it shortens stuns on the Guardian instead.

nodes.name: High Guard
nodes.description: After you strike, your guard comes back up harder.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Level 50 Passive. After using Raise Shield, Advance or Battle Rush, you are granted High Guard.'

nodes.name: Shield Unit
nodes.description: Each hit you take grants you attack power, 4% of the damage per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Each time you take damage, you gain 5% of the damage taken as attack power for 1 minute.'

nodes.name: King's Guard
nodes.description: Your Pulverize and Ram throw your shield back up before you need it.
nodes._source: Capstone. CoA: 'Your Pulverize and Ram now have a 10% chance to reset the cooldown of Raise Shield.' A proc cannot reset a cooldown, so it grants the block window the reset would have bought, plus the flat mitigation that makes it a capstone. CoA rates Vanguard 'the safest tank in COA ... Nearly unkillable, just slower kills'.
